DISCOVER THE TECHNOLOGY WE USE TO
HULL
The carbon epoxy laminate with PVC core, makes for a light and
robust structure that is set to last in time.
Thin gelcoat layer: this allows for an easily maintainable and repairable surface; small scratches or small damages can be effortlessly repaired to keep your hull in top condition.
Delrin Main Foil and Rudder Bearings: CNC machined bearings allow
for a consistent, tight fit between your foils and the boat.
WINGS
Composed of three assemblies:
▫ Front Beam
▫ Stern Beam
▫ 2 Outboard Beam
​
Two prepreg vacuum moulded centre pieces and four corner pieces are moulded in aluminium tooling and bonded with CST wound tubes using CNC machined jigs so that the assembly is light, stiff and consistent.
SPARS
A 3 piece system with CST carbon mast tubes was chosen for repeatability and consistency.
Carbon 15 degree Bent Boom: Milled Anodized Aluminum Vang Lever
FOIL
No compromise in performance: A mix of High Modulus prepreg  and
Intermediate Modulus prepreg is implemented in the layup of the foils
resulting in excellent stiffness and strength and accuracy to our strict One Design standards
ONE-DESIGN TECHNOLOGY
Every part of the Switch is built to the highest quality standards. With CNC
machined moulds and tooling, numerically controlled cutting machines and rigorous quality control Element6Evolution ensures the tightest possible tolerance on every component.
Computerized Numerical Control precision
•  Hull and deck moulds are 100% carbon/epoxy from a CNC made master plug.
•  Aluminium CNC tooling is used for all wing and foil parts.
Computerized Numerical Control Cut material
All fabrics, prepreg and cores are cut on CNC controlled cutting machines guaranteeing accuracy and repeatability.
Quality Control inspections
•  All the components and materials go through a purpose designed quality control system.
•  Geometry, weight and stiffness are checked.
Event Checks
Element6 will supply to the Switch Class Measurers rigs and templates that will be used at national and international events to ensure conformity of all components and fair racing.
SWITCH
STRICT ONE-DESIGN

sections.title: Página Switch is Smart
sections.intro:
READY TO GO!
SWITCH IS SMART
When you receive your Switch you are ready to go!
Ready to Race out of the box: spliced lines and pre-tuned control systems for first day sailing
Intuitive and simple controls: Vang, Cunningham and Ride height
Easily removable wing tramps: tramps are easily to fit without any rope work
Travel Logistic
When you have to travel or store your Switch you won’t have much to care about.
​
EASY STORAGE: With disassemble wings and tramps the boat can be easily stored
TRAVEL BOX: When fully disassembled
the boat can be easily packed in its aluminium ( extra) box to minimize shipping expenses
THREE-PIECE CARBON MAST: Mast, boom and sail will be able to be carried by plane to events all around the globe where you will only have to charter the hull!
SWITCH
STRICT ONE-DESIGN
